name: Share-A-Cart
description:
Share-A-Cart lets Claude search live product catalogs, find current deals, and turn what you need into a shareable shopping cart. Ask in plain English — a classroom supply list, a recipe, a gift idea, or a party for 20 — and get back a checkout-ready link anyone can open.

Search products on Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, eBay, Kroger, Kohl's, Macy's, Ulta Beauty, AliExpress, and more. Compare the same items across stores, look up product details, and check Share-A-Cart deals for coupons, sales, and featured discounts (including educator offers).

When the list is ready, Claude builds a cart and saves it to your Share-A-Cart account. You get a single link to review, send to a parent, teacher, roommate, or purchasing office, or open at the retailer with the items already loaded. Checkout happens on the store's own site — Share-A-Cart never sees your retailer login or payment information.

Key features:
Live product search across major retailers
Product details by item ID
Current deals, coupon codes, and featured offers
Create or update shareable carts from a conversation or search
Reopen carts saved in your account history
One checkout-ready link per cart, ready to share

Connect once with a free Share-A-Cart account. After that, just ask Claude to shop.

Disclosure: Product, deal, and cart links from this connector may include affiliate tracking. Share-A-Cart may earn a commission on purchases made through those links. This does not change the price you pay.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Share-A-Cart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Share-A-Cart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://share-a-cart.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Share-A-Cart MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share-A-Cart provides these MCP tools: sac_create_cart_from_search, sac_deals, sac_get_cart, sac_get_product, sac_save_cart, sac_search_items, and sac_vendor_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Share-A-Cart?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Share-A-Cart in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Share-A-Cart requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Share-A-Cart is developed by Share-A-Cart. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
